_meta.name: flux1-persephone-ip-adapter
_meta.purpose: Character multi-view generation using Persephone (Flux.1) + IP-Adapter v2. Replaces Flux.2 Klein's native image conditioning with IP-Adapter injection into Flux.1 for better quality. Takes a front-view reference image and generates a new view (side, back, three-quarter, custom pose) of the same character.
editable: 4.inputs.text (positive prompt — describe the new view/pose, keep identity blurb verbatim)
48.inputs.noise_seed (set to 0 for random seed each run)
130.inputs.ip_scale (IP-Adapter strength — default 0.85, lower = more creative freedom, higher = tighter consistency)
tips: IP-Adapter v2 is weaker on character consistency than Flux.2 native conditioning — expect some drift
Keep the identity/wardrobe/lighting portions of the prompt identical to the reference prompt
Only change the view/pose/stance sections of the prompt for new views
ip_scale 0.85 is a good balance — 1.0 can make the output too rigid, 0.7 gives more pose freedom
CLIP ViT-L/14 is the correct vision model for this IP-Adapter (not ViT-H)
This uses Flux.1 architecture — flux_vae.safetensors (not flux2-vae)
XlabsSampler handles its own noise/scheduling — do NOT use BasicGuider/BasicScheduler with IP-Adapter
timestep_to_start_cfg controls when CFG kicks in (default = steps = full CFG throughout)
true_gs is the actual guidance value fed to the model (equivalent to FluxGuidance)

architecture.model: Persephone (Flux.1) — uncensored, higher base quality than Klein
architecture.conditioning: IP-Adapter v2 via LoadFluxIPAdapter + ApplyFluxIPAdapter (patches UNET, not conditioning)
architecture.sampler: XlabsSampler (x-flux-comfyui built-in sampler — REQUIRED for IP-Adapter compatibility)
architecture.tradeoff: Better image quality vs weaker identity consistency than Klein's native conditioning

inputs.text: A full-body character sheet, side view, three-quarter angle, wide angle full-length shot from head to toe. A hyper-realistic athletic woman with a sharp jawline and intense eyes. She has a highly defined, toned physique with visible abdominal muscles and muscular thighs. Sun-kissed skin with visible pores. Standing in a relaxed contrapposto pose. Full anatomical nudity, detailed muscular and pelvic anatomy. Plain white background, studio lighting, 8k, highly detailed. Shot on 35mm lens, wide field of view.
